snippet.title: Ate In Spain
snippet.description:
🇪🇸 Ate in Spain
Digital Nomad in Spain | Web VA 💻 | Product Manager 👩🏻‍💼 | Dog Mom to a very spoiled Dachshund 🐶🐾


Hey, I’m Ate in Spain 🇪🇸💛

I’m just a Filipina who once dreamed of starting a new life in Spain and somehow made it happen. What began as me figuring things out alone turned into a space where I get to help others do the same.

Here, I share real stories, lessons, and little wins from this journey — the good, the hard, and everything in between. 🌿No filters, no gatekeeping. Just me, sharing life in Spain with my laptop, my coffee, and my spoiled little dachshund 🐶☕✨

If you’re a fellow Filipino (or anyone!) dreaming of moving abroad and own fresh start, I hope my journey gives you courage and comfort to take that first step.  ✨

 Let’s chase this dream and figure it out together.✨ 🇪🇸💛



🌐www.ateinspain.com
💌contact@help.ateinspain.com

snippet.title: Everything is Boffo
snippet.description:
¡Hola and welcome to Everything is Boffo! 🎉

We’re two adventurous Filipinos who once packed our bags for the American dream and spent 13 unforgettable years in sunny California 🌴☀️. But after realizing the US immigration system was like a long tunnel with no light at the end, we decided to sell everything we owned — and start fresh in Valencia, Spain 🇪🇸.

Fast-forward 4+ incredible years, countless tapas, and more “¡hola!” than we can count… we’re now officially Spanish citizens! 💃🕺🇪🇸

Here, we share the real, unfiltered (but joy-filled) life of expats — from navigating bureaucracy without losing our minds, to soaking up Europe’s breathtaking landscapes, to discovering the quirks, traditions, and magic of Spanish living.

So if you’re dreaming of moving abroad, craving travel inspiration, or just want to see what happens when two Filipinos fall head over heels for Spain, you’re in the right place.

Pack your curiosity, bring your appetite, and join us on this adventure.
¡Vamos! ✈️🥘🌍

snippet.title: YouTooSpain
snippet.description:
YouTooSpain is the practical survival guide for English-speakers moving to and living in Spain.

I’m Skatz, based in Cómpeta in Málaga province, and this channel helps you understand Spanish visas, residency, taxes, healthcare, driving, property, bureaucracy, cost of living and real everyday life in Spain.

Whether you’re planning a move to Spain, already living here, or trying to avoid expensive mistakes, I try to give you the real picture — not the tabloid version, not the fantasy version.

Expect weekly videos, Monday live Q&As with a network of trusted experts, and practical guides for Brits, Americans and other English-speakers navigating life in Spain.

snippet.title: Savvy Nomad
snippet.description:
Want to keep more of your income while living abroad?

If you're a digital nomad, expat, or remote worker living abroad, you're probably paying more taxes than you have to. Savvy Nomad can help you legally reduce your taxes overseas, navigate international banking, and live abroad without the financial stress. Our mission is to help American expats and nomads travel freely, explore more, and get the most out of their income.

What we cover: 
→ Florida domicile & state income tax elimination (save 4%–14.8%) 
→ Expat tax strategies — FBAR, FEIE, Foreign Tax Credit
→ A real, non-CMRA residential address accepted by banks & government agencies 
→ Mail forwarding so you can effortlessly manage your US mail from anywhere in the world

💸 Ready to stop overpaying? Contact us at www.savvynomad.io
🌐 New videos every week!

DISCLAIMER: All content is for general educational purposes only. Savvy Nomad is not a law firm, tax advisor, financial advisor, or government agency.

snippet.title: Days We Spend
snippet.description:
If you’re looking for tips and advice on how you travel the world longer, relocate to Europe, embrace van life without spending tens of thousands of dollars, or plan for your first (or 50th!) Camino de Santiago — you’ve come to the right place.  

We started Days We Spend with a simple goal — to share how we spend our time while traveling the world. Then a funny thing happened.

You guys started following along. And you had some questions.

In 2021, we turned our Honda Element into a micro RV. We've walked across Spain multiple times, traveled around the world for a year, and in 2023 we made the leap to move to Spain full-time on an Non-Lucrative Visa.

Shawn Forno is a travel writer with 15+ years of experience writing for clients and publications including Lonely Planet, Tortuga Backpacks, Matt D’Avella, and HuffPo. Lainey Silver is an international Swing Dance teacher, choreographer, and performer with a client roster that includes Disney, Carnegie Hall, and Lincoln Center.
